server.bind.description: Network address and port the server listens on (host:port format)

server.workdir.description: Base directory for job artifacts, logs, and internal state

server.max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent build jobs the server will accept

server.tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the API endpoint

server.tls.cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format)

server.tls.key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format)

database.dsn.description: Database connection string. Use SQLite for dev; PostgreSQL for production

logging.file.description: Path to log file; use '-' to log to stdout

cleanup.job_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain completed jobs before automatic cleanup

cleanup.archive_before_delete.description: Whether to compress job artifacts before deleting them after retention period

env.description: Additional environment variables to inject for builds using this toolchain

max_jobs.description: Maximum concurrent jobs allowed under this profile

cpu_limit.description: CPU share/milliseconds per job (e.g., 1000 = 1 CPU core)
